description.en: Windows desktop reminder when a session finishes, needs your input, or fails: a corner unread badge that lists session names and jumps to the session on click, Web Audio chimes, taskbar flashing, and a tray whale icon with a numeric badge. Only visible (non-archived, non-subagent) sessions count; seven settings including a zh/en switch.
description.zh: Windows 桌面端会话结束、需要你回答或出错时提醒：角落未读浮层列出会话名并可点击跳转、Web Audio 双音效、任务栏闪烁、托盘小鲸鱼叠加数字徽章，只统计看得见的会话（已归档/子代理不计），七项设置含中英文切换。
